headline: Samsung has new Galaxy headphones in the works
summary: Samsung's Galaxy Wearable app code hints at upcoming over-ear headphones. Reportedly named "Galaxy H1," they could rival Apple's AirPods Max. These would be Samsung's first over-ear headphones, possibly launching in 2027.

headline: A RAMageddon guide to back-to-school laptop shopping
summary: Laptop prices are surging for students due to ongoing RAM and storage shortages. Some models are slightly pricier, while others are wildly more expensive. This guide helps navigate the market for affordable back-to-school laptops.

headline: Lamborghini’s flagship Revuelto levels up with SV trim
summary: Lamborghini's new Revuelto SV focuses on driver-vehicle unity, not distraction minimization. This flagship supercar introduces an upgraded, performance-focused SV trim. The company aims for a more immersive and rewarding driving experience.

headline: The X-Files creator Chris Carter wanted to make a more horrific movie
summary: Chris Carter originally envisioned a grisly, supernatural X-Files film. 20th Century Fox executives preferred a different direction for "I Want to Believe." Carter aimed for a darker story exploring faith, which was ultimately changed.

headline: Save $3,100 Off the Massive 83" LG Evo M3 4K OLED TV With Wireless Connectivity and 5 Year Warranty
summary: The 83" LG Evo M3 4K OLED TV is currently at its lowest price ever. Shoppers can save $3,100 on this massive 2023 premium model. It features wireless connectivity and comes with a 5-year warranty.

headline: Mulholland Drive’s 4K Criterion Collection Edition Drops to a New All-Time Low Price
summary: Mulholland Drive's 4K Criterion Collection edition has reached a new record low price. The special edition Blu-ray is now available for under $21 on Amazon. This marks the most affordable price yet for the acclaimed film's 4K version.

headline: Toy Story 3 Will Be Delisted on Xbox Just Weeks Before Launch of New Remaster
summary: The original Toy Story 3 video game is set to be delisted from the Xbox digital store. This removal comes just weeks before the launch of its new remaster in October. Gamers have a limited window to purchase the original title digitally.

headline: First Look at James Spader as Ultron in VisionQuest Shown at D23
summary: Marvel unveiled a first look at James Spader as Ultron in "VisionQuest" at D23. A special teaser for the series was spotted on the Anaheim Convention Center floor. Fans got an exclusive glimpse of Ultron alongside other show details.

headline: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism row, found dead
summary: Jason Arday, a former Cambridge professor involved in a plagiarism controversy, has been found dead. Emergency services discovered him unresponsive at a Battersea, south London address. Arday was a prominent academic whose passing follows recent public scrutiny.

headline: Temporary ban on sale of disposable BBQs over wildfire risk
summary: A temporary ban has been imposed on the sale of disposable barbecues. The government cites a "significant risk to the public" amidst current drought and heatwave conditions. The measure aims to prevent wildfires across affected regions.

headline: Mangione admits killing healthcare CEO and pleads guilty to federal charges
summary: Mangione has pleaded guilty to federal charges, admitting to killing a healthcare CEO. He confessed to shooting Mr. Thompson in Manhattan, leading to his death. The 28-year-old pleaded guilty to charges including stalking resulting in death.

headline: Derailed Essex to London train leads to travel chaos
summary: A train derailment between Essex and London has caused widespread travel disruption. Over 60 patients were assessed by ambulance crews at the scene of the incident. All individuals were fortunately discharged at the scene, with no serious injuries reported.
